source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All auction, bid, creative, screen and publisher identifiers are synthetic.

No site/app, personal device identity, ip or ua is present, matching the DOOH-only shape; device is a bare object (devicetype only) so device.ip/ua omission is judged at the DOOH-appropriate INFO level rather than being read as a personal-device gap.
imp.qty models an audience multiplier per OpenRTB 2.6 §3.2.7 (Object: Imp), independently authored, not copied from any single named example.
provenance.sanitized: No production payload or PII used. All resource and tracking hosts end in .test; external network must remain blocked.

pairApplicability.note: Use x-openrtb-version: 2.6 when replaying HTTP; envelope itself has no version field.

specNotes: packages/core/rules-request.js downgrades device.ip_required/device.ua_required from ERROR to INFO whenever the request is DOOH-only (channels.length===1 && 'dooh'); this case exercises that path for a video bid rather than banner-dooh-26-screen's display bid, so no known gap is recorded here.

device MUST still be present as an object — an entirely absent device triggered request.device_required at error level when this case was authored (DEF-103, resolved by 021 on 2026-09-08: warning now); this case supplies a bare {devicetype:8} object precisely to avoid that unrelated failure while still testing the ip/ua downgrade.
mtype=2 and bid.dur=12 both fall inside imp.video.minduration/maxduration (10-15); neither field is validated by packages/core/rules-response.js today (no finding either way).
Validity describes protocol structure and declared constraints; generated media bytes must be checked against declared MIME/duration before playback tests.
Current Inspector contract displays VAST as inert XML; text visibility must not be counted as creative rendering or media playback.
fixtureAssets lists controlled resources; intercept .test URLs locally. Never fetch public advertising/tracking hosts.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.

preview.capabilityGap: The current VAST preview is inert XML; video/audio playback and Wrapper resolution are not implemented.
